label: Best in Class
corporate_parent: Carrier Global Corporation — independent publicly traded company (NYSE: CARR). 2020 UTC spinoff. Fortune 500. Headquarters: Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
manufacturing_location: Condenser units: Collierville, TN. Charlotte, NC facility.

compressor.description: Copeland variable-speed scroll compressor with Greenspeed Intelligence. True DC inverter modulation from 25% to 100% capacity. Infinite staging for precise load matching.
compressor.supplier: Copeland (Emerson/Copeland) — ZPD series variable-speed scroll. Sidney, OH manufacturing.

condenser_coil.description: Traditional copper tube/aluminum fin construction on Infinity line. WeatherArmor Ultra corrosion protection coating. Some lower Carrier lines (Performance, Comfort) use microchannel — Infinity retains traditional for durability.
condenser_coil.coil_durability_note: Traditional copper/aluminum coils last 4-5x longer than microchannel per industry data.

expansion_device.description: Electronic Expansion Valve for precise refrigerant metering. Required for optimal variable-speed compressor performance.

fan_motor.description: Variable-speed brushless DC condenser fan motor. 75%+ efficiency. Composite fan blade for reduced noise.

cabinet.construction: Heavy gauge galvanized steel, WeatherArmor Ultra protection, louvered coil guard
cabinet.source_traceability: Carrier Global — Collierville, TN manufacturing identified

communicating_system.thermostat_requirement: Requires Infinity thermostat for full communicating operation. Standard 24V thermostat requires adapter kit — loses some variable-speed features.
communicating_system.proprietary_lock_in: Moderate — communicating system is proprietary but adapter kit available for non-Infinity thermostats.

performance_evidence.eer2: Varies by configuration — check AHRI Directory for specific model/coil combination
performance_evidence.cold_weather_performance: Heat pump version operates to -15°F+ with maintained capacity
performance_evidence.energy_star: ENERGY STAR certified. ENERGY STAR Most Efficient eligible.

warranty.claim_process: Standard — Carrier warranty process is middle-of-road per contractor consensus

parts_availability.distribution: Carrier Enterprise (captive distribution). Some independent availability. Not as open as Goodman.
parts_availability.lead_time: Standard — most common parts in stock at Carrier Enterprise locations

service_network.type: National certified dealer network + independent contractors
service_network.proprietary_diagnostics: Infinity diagnostics — some advanced troubleshooting benefits from Carrier dealer tools

durability_evidence.coil_corrosion_protection: WeatherArmor Ultra coating — factory-applied corrosion protection
durability_evidence.control_board_reliability: Infinity communicating system mature (10+ years in market). Proven reliable per contractor consensus.
durability_evidence.refrigerant: R-410A current production; transitioning to R-454B (A2L) on newer models

platform_sharing.sibling_product: Bryant Evolution 180B = same compressor and board as Carrier Infinity. Different thermostat software and badge. Different authorized dealer network.
platform_sharing.component_identity: High — Carrier Infinity and Bryant Evolution share compressor, coil, cabinet platform. Differentiation is primarily in thermostat ecosystem and dealer channel.
platform_sharing.scoring_rule: Report must disclose Carrier/Bryant platform sharing per Rule 19.

professional_consensus.installer_recommendation: Strong recommend for premium homes. Most forgiving of installation quality alongside Trane — robust build tolerates mediocre ductwork.
professional_consensus.reliability_ranking: Top tier — fewest callbacks among premium variable-speed per contractor consensus
professional_consensus.value_proposition: Top-of-line Carrier, priced below Lennox flagship, competitive with Trane XV20i
